response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(L.HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(L.HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM p) SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.avg_wbc, p.ratio, p.ratio - m.mean_ratio AS diff FROM p, m WHERE p.ratio > m.mean_ratio ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
